question: Can partial source-qualified feature profiles describe most confirmed writing, including class-resistant forms, and predict heldout visual similarity?

methodology_changes.basis: Trial1 overall descriptor perturbation results and documented normalization/semantic limitations, not V3-class-stratified rates or downstream outcomes.
methodology_changes.retained: Aspect, density, centroid/spread,3x3 ink distribution, run and cavity measurements; original tolerances retained except dimensions.
methodology_changes.secondary: Skeleton endpoints/branches, component count and redundant thirds retained but neither required for usability nor used in similarity distances. Native dimensions recorded separately and excluded from cross-capture similarity.
methodology_changes.normalization: Full body±10% reference range log(1.1/0.9)=0.20067 plus permitted native log-dimension measurement span0.18 totals0.38067. Fixed0.40 normalized tolerance accommodates both; native log dimensions retain0.18 tolerance. No body-scale perturbation can alone force failure.
methodology_changes.source_qualification: Raw raster repeatability and source-visible feature evidence remain separate. Cavity descriptors enter source-qualified core profiles only with matching resolved source-visible count; upper/lower/centroid fields additionally require resolved compatible source placement. Counts disagreeing with source or unaudited remain source-unknown, never imputed.

usable: Confirmed writing and resolved whole parent, unique whole-parent raster correspondence across6/9/12(IoU>=0.5, no split/merge),>=8 stable source-qualified core fields, geometry+distribution+at least run or cavity. Source contacts/insufficient evidence block usability; all confirmed writing remains in primary coverage denominator. Secondary graph failures do not block.

samples.reference: Seeded up to8 source-resolved confirmed parents in each of11 Trial1 caption groups; no class selection; reference image features source-audited after specification. Historical source data additionally reported as sensitivity, not fresh test.
samples.selection: First existing overview-triaged ordinary horizontal field per6 captions unused for Trial1/V6 feature tuning, source-only geometry/contrast/layout. All primary CC proposals with area>=35 and core support>=8 inspected. Photographic failure retained; no replacement based on results. Report parent-proposal sampling limits, not full writing-ink recall.
samples.exposure: Some source captions had old V3/V4 imagery exposure; fresh for Trial2 specification, not globally unseen photographs.
samples.source_membership: Every selected proposal reviewed native RGB/whole field before feature/V3 suggestions; nonwriting/unresolved excluded from confirmed denominator but enumerated. Visible missing parent fragments may be added as explicit source cases, never assumed recovered.

questions: cavity placement upper/lower/both/none/unknown relative envelope mid-height, near-midpoint±0.05 ambiguous
source_audit.definition_discordance: Visible vs significant raster cavities can differ; score agreement and source qualification separately without retuning cutoff.

similarity.profile_distance: Equal-weight family means of stable shared-core absolute midpoint differences divided by preregistered tolerance(counts scale1), clipped3. Geometry/distribution/run/cavity. At least8 shared fields and geometry+distribution+run/cavity. Add0.10*(1-shared_core/25) observability penalty. No learned label weights.
baselines: symmetric24px contour Chamfer from frozen aspect-preserving48px normalization
50/50 contour+aspect, each scaled by reference-only cross-caption95th percentile and clipped1
similarity.pairs: Seeded up to12 resolved writing anchors per fresh caption. For each: closest eligible feature reference, closest contour reference, and seeded aspect-matched(log aspect difference<=0.35) random reference. Deduplicate; retain selector provenance. Pair proposals formed without V3 labels or source similarity outcomes.
similarity.source_judgment: Randomized anonymous RGB pairs, predictions/selectors/V3 hidden; rate2=same whole visual organization allowing ink/size/slant variation,1=partial shared organization,0=different organization,U=unresolvable. These pair judgments do not define transitive discrete classes or internal units.
similarity.metrics: Primary AUROC rating2 vs0; exclude1/U but report all four counts. Secondary ordinal association on0/1/2. Paired6-caption bootstrap of AUROC differences; reference/anchor repeats acknowledged. No fit on test judgments.
similarity.better_than_baseline_gate: Feature AUROC≥0.75; delta≥0.05 with bootstrap95% lower>0 against each of aspect,contour,combined;>=120 resolved2/0 pairs,>=30 per category and6 captions. If not, preserve failure, no feature/weight tuning.

V3_diagnostics: Only after source decisions/feature specification/metric seal. Apply frozen V3 unchanged to fresh resolved writing. Existing source labels projected for reporting only. Known-family cross-caption feature distances vs within-caption shuffled labels(999 nulls), classes with>=5 parents and>=3 captions; no learned class metric. Report coherence and leave-caption retrieval without altering profiles.
unknown_recurrence: Continuous neighborhood evidence, not clusters: threshold distance<=0.25 with>=8 common core and3 families; count unknown confirmed parents having a neighbor in another caption and support in>=3 captions. Reference-to-fresh transport separately. Null999 within-caption independent whole-family vector permutations retaining missingness and exact caption size; observed/null both dependence-limited. No new class label, equivalence relation or sequence token.
acceptance: Coverage/source agreement and similarity superiority are separate gates. Report descriptive partial-profile support separately from prediction superiority; no single combined accuracy score. No classes required to occupy compact regions; coherent V3/unknown neighborhoods remain validation results, not tuning inputs.
stages: prepare and source-adjudicate all reference/new objects and visual fields
seal source judgments before feature suggestions
seal metric inputs before similarity rating/V3 analyses
anonymous heldout similarity review and repeat subset
V3 diagnostic and continuous unknown recurrence tests
freeze Trial2 before any position/section/transcription/sequence correlation
repeat: Seeded12 similarity pairs shown anonymously again after source/feature work with original IDs and decisions hidden. Same-adjudicator repeatability only; unresolved/ties retained.
downstream: No position, section, conventional transcription or sequence correlation before Trial2 freeze; this task does not authorize reopening them afterwards.
